disclosures.name: TestWeightedAcquire
disclosures.reason: runtime-capability: the test gives each tryAcquire a 10 ms context deadline, and under the -tests host's configuration of record (Release, tiered compilation off) the FIRST call JIT-compiles the Acquire path at full optimization before its select runs, which on the measuring box (linux/amd64, 4 cores) takes longer than 10 ms, so ctx.Done() is already closed: tries[0] reads false and the warm second call reads true (tries[1]). The converted closure is faithful (semaphore_test.cs: ctx is never reassigned). Discriminator, same box, same converter: -test-tiered gives semaphore 8/8 and the module 28 matched, the windows bank's count, so the divergence is first-call JIT latency, not conversion. Measured 2 of 2 runs untiered. A faster host that passes it reports this entry ORPHANED (report-only, the row still validates). Retires if the host's configuration of record warms or tiers first calls. COORD ruling 2026-10-12 (wave 2): disclose with the -test-tiered discriminator as the evidence.
